name: Crystal Blooms
source:
This is a Steven Universe fan game revolving around Pearl and Amethyst getting to know each other in a flowershop AU. 

[From [url=https://dragonandbadger.itch.io/crystal-blooms]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这是一部《宇宙小子》同人游戏，背景设定在花店AU，讲述珍珠和紫水晶逐渐了解彼此的故事。

[来源：[url=https://dragonandbadger.itch.io/crystal-blooms]Itch.io[/url]]
